title: Canonical comparison from a derived stalk to strict-local total-space sections
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→S, an abelian etale sheaf G on X, and a geometric point s of S, define the strict-local comparison on G[0] by deriving the unique restriction from the stalk at s to sections of the inverse image on S_(s), applying derived exchange for the cartesian square X×_S S_(s), applying Leray, and finally the canonical exact inverse-image/single-functor comparison. The restriction is a natural transformation, and all its data are the unique maps characterized by their pointed-neighbourhood germ equations.
